map.活体溺死时，溺水者吸入大量水，水中的硅藻随血液循环经肺循环进入左心，再由体循环到: During antemortem drowning the victim inhales a large amount of water, and the diatoms in it travel through the pulmonary circulation via the lungs into the left heart and then reach all internal organs (liver, kidney, spleen, bone marrow and so on) through the systemic circulation. Diatoms can therefore be detected in the organs of a drowned person.
map.死后入水（抛尸入水）者无呼吸运动，硅藻不能进入循环，内脏中不能检出（或仅肺中有少: In post-mortem immersion (a body thrown into the water) there is no respiratory movement, so diatoms cannot enter the circulation and are not detected in the organs (or only a few in the lungs).
map.：取内脏组织，用浓硝酸/双氧水破坏有机质，离心沉淀后显微镜下检查硅藻: : take organ tissue, destroy the organic matter with concentrated nitric acid or hydrogen peroxide, centrifuge to sediment, then examine for diatoms under the microscope
map.：肺、肝、肾、脾、骨髓（封闭器官取材可排除污染）: : lung, liver, kidney, spleen and bone marrow (sampling closed organs rules out contamination)
map.：需取溺水点水样做硅藻种类和数量对照: : a water sample from the drowning point is needed as a reference for diatom species and counts
map.硅藻检验结果评价标准: Evaluation Standards for Diatom Test Results
map.肺+肝/肾/脾/骨髓均检出硅藻: Diatoms detected in lung plus liver/kidney/spleen/bone marrow
map.仅肺检出硅藻: Diatoms detected only in the lungs
map.不能确定（死后入水肺中可有少量硅藻）: Inconclusive (post-mortem immersion may yield a few diatoms in the lungs)
map.肺+肝/肾检出且种类与水样一致: Diatoms in lung plus liver/kidney with species matching the water sample
map.支持溺死（骨髓为封闭器官，不易污染）: Supports drowning (bone marrow is a closed organ, resistant to contamination)
map.各内脏均未检出: No diatoms detected in any organ
map.不支持溺死，或水中硅藻过少: Does not support drowning, or too few diatoms in the water
map.• 硅藻检验需排除实验室污染（操作全程防污染）: The test must exclude laboratory contamination (prevent contamination throughout the procedure)
map.• 骨髓、肾为较好检材（封闭器官，不易受外界污染）: Bone marrow and kidney are good samples (closed organs, less exposed to outside contamination)
map.• 硅藻种类需与溺水点水样对照一致才有诊断价值: Diatom species must match the water sample from the drowning point to have diagnostic value
map.• 腐败尸体硅藻检验仍有一定价值（硅藻耐酸耐腐）: The test still has some value on decomposed bodies (diatoms resist acid and decay)
map.• 非溺死者内脏一般不能检出硅藻（自来水硅藻极少）: Organs of people who did not drown generally contain no diatoms (tap water has very few)
map.：口鼻部泡沫（蕈状泡沫）、手中抓有水草/泥沙、手脚表皮浸泡发白（洗衣妇手）: : foam at the mouth and nose (mushroom-like foam), water plants or silt grasped in the hands, whitened sodden skin on the hands and feet (washerwoman's hand)
map.：肺部水性肺气肿、Paltauf斑（肺膜下出血斑）、胃内溺液: : watery pulmonary oedema, Paltauf spots (subpleural haemorrhages), drowning fluid in the stomach
map.：左右心血电解质差异（溺淡水：左心血稀释，钠/氯降低）、血红蛋白稀释等: : electrolyte differences between left and right cardiac blood (in freshwater drowning the left cardiac blood is diluted with lower sodium and chloride), haemoglobin dilution and so on

map.依硅藻经「肺→左心→体循环」途径，比较各脏器（肺、肝、肾、脾、骨髓）硅藻检出部位: Following the lungs → left heart → systemic circulation route, compare where diatoms are found and in what quantity across the organs (lung, liver, kidney, spleen, bone marrow). Antemortem drowning shows whole-body distribution with species matching the scene water, whereas post-mortem immersion is limited to the respiratory tract.
map.肺、肝、肾、骨髓均检出硅藻且种类与水样 3 种匹配，数量随循环递减（肺>肝>肾>: With diatoms in lung, liver, kidney and bone marrow and 3 species matching the water sample, counts decreasing along the circulation (lung > liver > kidney > bone marrow), this supports antemortem aspiration of water. If only the lungs are positive and downstream organs negative, this leans toward post-mortem immersion.
map.若脏器硅藻种类与现场水样不同，提示可能在他处溺死或标本污染，种类一致才支持「在该: If the diatom species in the organs differ from the scene water sample, this suggests drowning happened elsewhere or the specimen is contaminated; only consistent species supports reconstructing the scene as drowning in that water body.

map.两者同属硅藻法，detector-10 偏内脏阳性判定与计分，本工具偏循环途径与: Both belong to the diatom method. detector-10 focuses on organ positivity determination and scoring, while this tool focuses on mechanistic inference of the circulation route and distribution order; the conclusions should corroborate each other.
map.根据各内脏器官（肺、肝、肾、脾、骨髓）硅藻检出数量，辅助诊断溺死并评价检验结果可: Uses diatom counts in each internal organ (lung, liver, kidney, spleen, bone marrow) to assist the drowning diagnosis and evaluate the reliability of the test.
